problem: Invoice received without purchase order number
symptoms: AP cannot match invoice to internal request or approval workflow
analysis: Common AP processing gap. Missing PO/reference prevents routing, approval, and posting.
solution: Put invoice on hold. Contact requester/vendor to obtain PO number or internal cost center and approver. Do not post or pay until ownership and approval path are identified.

problem: Duplicate invoice suspected in accounts payable
symptoms: Same vendor, amount, and invoice number appears more than once
analysis: Potential duplicate payment risk. Need three-way validation (vendor, invoice no., date/amount).
solution: Block payment and compare vendor name, invoice number, issue date, due date, amount, currency, and IBAN. Check whether one record is a credit note or corrected invoice. Keep only one payable item after verification.

problem: Vendor changed bank account details by email
symptoms: AP received payment instruction update with urgency wording
analysis: High fraud risk (BEC/social engineering). Bank account change must follow strict verification.
solution: Do not change bank details based on email alone. Verify using approved out-of-band process (known phone contact or supplier portal), require documented approval, and log who validated the change and when.

problem: Payment overdue because invoice approval is stuck
symptoms: Invoice is in system but no approver action before due date
analysis: Workflow bottleneck in approval matrix. Need escalation path and audit trail.
solution: Identify current approver and aging days. Trigger escalation to backup approver/manager per policy. Record reason for delay, prioritize payment if services are critical, and review approval matrix to prevent repeat blockage.

problem: Employee expense claim missing receipt
symptoms: Expense submitted with amount and category but no supporting document
analysis: Insufficient documentation for reimbursement and accounting compliance.
solution: Return claim for completion. Request receipt or acceptable substitute documentation per policy. If receipt is unavailable, require manager approval and written justification before any exception is processed.

problem: Customer payment received but cannot be matched to invoice
symptoms: Bank statement shows incoming transfer with unclear reference
analysis: AR cash application issue. Need payer identification and remittance details.
solution: Post payment to suspense/unapplied account temporarily. Check bank reference, variable symbol, invoice number, payer name, and CRM/order records. Contact customer for remittance advice if needed before final allocation.

problem: Credit note received but original invoice already paid
symptoms: Vendor issued credit note after payment completion
analysis: Need proper AP/AR handling: offset against future invoice or request refund.
solution: Record credit note against vendor account. If future invoices are expected, offset the next payable. Otherwise request vendor refund and track until received. Keep clear link between credit note and original invoice.

problem: Monthly close delayed because departments submit accruals late
symptoms: Finance cannot finalize month-end due to missing cost estimates
analysis: Recurring close process governance issue. Need cutoff calendar and owner accountability.
solution: Enforce month-end close calendar with submission deadlines by department. Use provisional accruals where policy allows, log late submissions, and review variances next month to improve estimate quality.

problem: Wrong cost center used on posted invoice
symptoms: Invoice is posted but expense appears in incorrect department budget
analysis: Coding error after posting; requires correcting journal entry or reclassification.
solution: Create reclassification entry to move cost from incorrect to correct cost center with audit note referencing original document. Obtain approval from finance lead or controller per policy.

problem: Invoice due date differs from contract payment terms
symptoms: Vendor invoice says payable in 7 days, contract says 30 days
analysis: Discrepancy between invoice and master agreement. Contract terms usually govern unless amendment exists.
solution: Validate supplier contract/master data. Use contracted payment terms unless a documented exception or amendment was approved. Inform vendor if invoice terms are inconsistent and request corrected invoice if necessary.

problem: Finance asks how to handle partial payment from customer
symptoms: Received amount is lower than invoice total
analysis: AR underpayment may be short-pay, deduction, fee, or dispute. Requires reason code and follow-up.
solution: Apply received amount partially to invoice (if ERP supports), leave residual open, and classify residual reason (dispute, bank fees, rounding, customer deduction). Contact customer and sales owner for resolution.

problem: Reimbursement request in foreign currency without exchange rate documentation
symptoms: Expense claim includes foreign receipt but missing conversion basis
analysis: Need consistent FX conversion policy and evidence for accounting.
solution: Apply company FX policy (e.g., card statement rate or approved daily rate source), attach conversion evidence, and document the rate/date used before approval and posting.

problem: Vendor invoice missing mandatory details
symptoms: Invoice lacks supplier ID, issue date, taxable data, or legal identifiers
analysis: Document quality issue; cannot safely post without required fields.
solution: Reject or hold invoice and request corrected version from vendor. Do not book/pay until mandatory invoice fields are complete per internal accounting/tax requirements.

problem: Purchase was made without prior approval and invoice is already due
symptoms: Maverick spend discovered in AP
analysis: Policy breach plus operational urgency. Need retroactive approval path and risk assessment.
solution: Route for urgent retroactive approval to budget owner and finance manager. Flag as policy exception, process payment only after approval, and record incident for procurement compliance review.

problem: Recurring SaaS invoice amount increased unexpectedly
symptoms: Subscription charge differs from previous months
analysis: Could be contract renewal, seat increase, FX change, or billing error.
solution: Compare current invoice against prior invoice, contract terms, user seat count, and renewal notices. Hold approval until variance is explained and documented.

problem: Bank payment export failed and no supplier payments were sent
symptoms: ERP shows payment batch created but bank file rejected or not uploaded
analysis: Payment operations issue; risk of missed due dates and duplicate retries.
solution: Stop manual ad-hoc retries. Verify batch status in ERP and bank portal, identify rejection reason, regenerate/export corrected file, and document whether any payments were partially transmitted to avoid duplicates.

problem: Employee asks when travel expense reimbursement will be paid
symptoms: Claim approved but no payment date communicated
analysis: Communication gap in expense workflow; reimbursement cycle unclear.
solution: Check claim status (submitted/approved/posted/queued for payment). Inform employee of the next reimbursement run date and any missing approvals/documents if payment is not yet scheduled.

problem: Finance needs to separate onboarding costs from regular HR costs
symptoms: Mixed invoices and expenses are posted to general HR cost center
analysis: Reporting issue; requires chart-of-accounts/cost center granularity and posting rules.
solution: Create dedicated cost center or analytic code for onboarding. Update AP coding rules and approval forms so recruitment, equipment, and first-day setup costs are tagged consistently.

problem: Customer asks for copy of paid invoice and proof of payment
symptoms: AR support request after settlement
analysis: Standard document retrieval request from finance/shared services.
solution: Provide invoice copy from ERP/document archive and payment confirmation reference (payment date, amount, transaction reference). Verify requester identity and authorization before sharing documents.

problem: Finance asks how to route an unclear accounting question to a human specialist
symptoms: Ticket contains vague wording or multiple topics (AP, AR, payroll, tax)
analysis: Need triage path when AI confidence is low or issue spans multiple finance domains.
solution: Tag the ticket as 'finance-review', summarize known facts, list missing inputs (invoice no., vendor, amount, due date, legal entity), and assign to finance specialist queue. Do not guess tax/accounting treatment when documents are incomplete.
